description: Query completed APB transfers with direction and exact, range, or mask address filters.
x-how_it_works: direction 与 address exact/range/mask 取 AND；先过滤再应用 1-based query.index、query.line_limit 或 last。旧 addr 和标量 address 被拒绝。
x-when_to_use: 抽取标准 APB completed transfer。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: name; address is exact/range/mask object
x-description-zh: 按方向以及 exact、range 或 mask 地址条件查询已完成 APB transfer。

use_when: Need completed APB transfer counts or rows filtered by direction and a canonical exact/range/mask address object.
do_not_use_when: Do not use it for AXI channel semantics, custom valid-ready fields, or a focused signal window around one APB transfer.

alternatives.when: Need aggregate APB counts and unresolved-filter diagnostics without transaction rows.
Inspect signal evidence around one APB transfer.

constraints: required: name; address is exact/range/mask object
